title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Non Decreasing
goal: Solve Minimum Operations to Make Array Non Decreasing: Pay for each adjacent drop and construct an optimal sequence of suffix increments.
strategy: Pay for each adjacent drop and construct an optimal sequence of suffix increments.

phasePurposes.compare: Measure the positive drop at the current boundary.
phasePurposes.apply: Pay for the suffix increment, or skip a zero drop.

edgeCases: Only positive adjacent drops add cost; each paid increment applies to a suffix, and already non-decreasing input costs zero.
inputRules: Enter a JSON array of 1–100,000 integers, each between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
